The sole supplied AP URL is titled “Netanyahu’s defiance of Trump on Gaza carries risks”; the prior retrieval records an article about Netanyahu’s position on Trump’s Gaza plan, which does not substantiate the Iran allegation. In this final pass, one focused Exa query targeted official records for the memorandum and an attributable Israeli warning, but Exa returned HTTP 504 with no results or source URLs. No additional query was attempted. A historical, unreviewed proposal reframed the entry as a separate Gaza-plan dispute; this hold does not adopt it because that would change the event identity. Keep the entry unresolved until event-specific evidence establishes the alleged agreement and warning.
